anti_rescue: After the first primary API call under RIL-API-ISOLATION-001, do not change the pinned model id, prompts, temperature, max_tokens, trial count, pass rule, payload allowlist, or fail-closed conditions. Redesign requires a new experiment ID.

claim_boundary.earned_if_pass: Two paired canary trials showed no observable cross-request canary inheritance across fresh independent Chat Completions API requests under the frozen protocol: each exposure request repeated its canary exactly, and each independent blind request returned exactly UNKNOWN.
not_earned: absence of hidden cross-request state at the provider

fail_closed_conditions: Any blind response contains its pair's canary (or the other pair's) as a substring.
Any request payload carries a key outside the allowlist or a message shape other than one user message.
The pinned model id is not listed by GET /v1/models at run start.
No credential is available from the Secure Vault connector.
pass_rule: Both pairs: exposure response repeats its canary exactly (positive control), and each blind response is exactly the token UNKNOWN with no canary from either pair present as a substring.

predecessor.lesson: Browser automation transport failed before primary contact. The isolation question moves to the API level, where the researcher substrate is a stateless HTTP request instead of a browser session.
predecessor.status: frozen-paused 2026-09-14: available VM failed egress preflight (ERR_EMPTY_RESPONSE at gemini.google.com/app); no primary contact; no credentials touched; no retry

protocol.canary_format: RILAPII-{1,2}-<48 lowercase hex chars>, fresh secrets.token_hex(24) per pair
per_call_rules: Receiver constructs the complete prompt each time.
Exactly one user message per request; no system/developer/assistant history.
Payload key allowlist: model, messages, temperature, max_tokens. Any other key fails closed before sending.
No thread id, no previous-response id, no conversation continuation, no stored message history, no cookies carried between calls.
No canary is generated until GET /v1/models confirms the pinned model id is listed (pre-canary gate).
The blind payload is byte-scanned for the canary before sending; a match fails closed without sending.
protocol.request_serialization: JSON with sort_keys and compact separators; request_sha256 is the sha256 of the exact bytes sent
protocol.trial_structure: 2 pairs = 4 API calls. Per pair: (a) exposure request — prompt contains the canary, demands exact repeat-back; (b) blind request — fresh independent request, prompt contains no canary anywhere, asks for the canary phrase, instructs the single exact token UNKNOWN if none was provided in this request.

records_per_call: prompt_text (all state passed into the call)
request_sha256 (sha256 of exact JSON payload bytes)
response_sha256 (sha256 of raw response body bytes)

research_question: Do fresh independent OpenAI Chat Completions requests preserve the observable cross-request canary boundary needed for a matched research comparison, with no conversation state supplied or observed?

substrate.api: Chat Completions (stateless by design); Responses/Assistants APIs are forbidden
substrate.credential_source: Secure Vault connector custom.openai via the dynamic_credentials helper; bearer_header placement; api.openai.com allowlist. Never from files, env vars, chat, or logs.
substrate.model_id_source: https://platform.openai.com/docs/models — 'GPT-6 Astra ... Model ID gpt-6-astra', described as the flagship model for complex reasoning and coding

successor_if_fail: Do not use this substrate for the matched comparison without a new qualification ID.
successor_if_pass: ANOMALY-003 may run the matched anomaly-first vs ordinary search on this substrate: GPT for both arms, a brand-new API request every round, only receiver-supplied arm-local history in each request.
title: API-request statelessness qualification for canary isolation (GPT)
